description: This file defines the 'Arabic' class which provides functionality to convert Roman numerals to Arabic numerals within the PhpSpreadsheet library's calculation module. It includes methods for recursive calculation, string processing, and handling various input types.

classes.name: Arabic
classes.description: Provides methods to convert Roman numerals to Arabic numerals, used in spreadsheet calculations.

methods.name: calculateArabic
methods.description: Recursively calculates the Arabic value from a Roman numeral array.

methods.name: mollifyScrutinizer
methods.description: Ensures the input is an array, returns empty array otherwise.

methods.name: strSplit
methods.description: Splits a Roman numeral string into its constituent characters.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Converts a Roman numeral (string or array) into its Arabic numeral equivalent.
